name: BMW R1100RS / R1150RS
engine: 1085 or 1130 cc air/oil-cooled boxer twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: The first oilhead sport tourers. Telelever, fuel injection and a clutch spline to keep greased.

K: Check and grease the clutch and transmission input splines. Dry splines are a known cause of wear on oilheads.

recallNote: BMW has issued several recalls across these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
